info.description:
The Electriplan web app's API. Every endpoint needs a Supabase access token (`Authorization: Bearer ...`). Endpoints that work inside one company take the `X-Organisation-Id` header and say which permission they need; errors come back as `{"message": "..."}`.

The floor-plan analyser (`/api/floorplan/...`) is a separate service and is not described here.
